parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main body of the globe, made of plastic and printed with a world map. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It represents the Earth and rotates around its axis to show different regions and continents.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the tilted axis supported by the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of durable plastic, with a height of about 15 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and supports the rotating axis of the globe.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
